canonical_project: Cloud X CX Data Center-1, Ust-Ilimsk district

notes: Kommersant reported Cloud X confirmed preparation to build a hyperscale AI/cloud data center in Zheleznodorozhny, Ust-Ilimsk district; 2,880 racks, 72 MW compute load, 154 MW planned consumption, first of three planned 154 MW sites near Ust-Ilimsk HPP, completion target 2027.
